Title: Introduction to Transformers and GPT
Summary: This chapter introduces the GPT acronym as Generative Pre-trained Transformer, explaining how these models generate text from large-scale pre-training. It highlights the transformer's role as the foundational architecture behind modern AI tools like ChatGPT, Dolly, and Midjourney, and outlines the core idea of predicting the next word in a sequence through iterative sampling.
